recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a desaturated, sepia-toned full-body portrait of a rock musician leaning against a dense, ornate wall of golden Victorian-style engraving and custom dimensional lettering. The background is filled with intricate swirls, musical icons, and floral elements rendered in a metallic gold and bronze palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the typographic block creates a physical interaction between 2D and 3D elements.
The desaturated, cool-toned subject contrasts against the warm, saturated gold of the graphic elements.
Dense, busy filigree in the background provides a texture that contrasts with the smooth, distressed paper texture of the outer frame.
coreInvariants: Metallic gold beveling on all primary text
Intricate line-art filigree filling all negative space within the graphic block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject positioned on the right third, vertically oriented, slightly overlapping the graphic elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large, dimensional display text at the top left, balanced by a heavy cluster of golden icons at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left name, flows down through the diagonal secondary text, and settles on the subject's face on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the design utilizes a 'horror vacui' approach where every inch of the graphic area is filled with detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Metallic Gold/Bronze for all graphic and typographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated Sepia/Grey for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Blue and Lavender ribbons providing a small pop of color in the center.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright gold highlights and the dark, recessed engraving lines.

letterConstructionRules: Swash extensions that integrate into the background filigree
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters are significantly larger and more ornate
Terminals end in sharp, western-style spurs or elegant curls
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, blocky Victorian serif paired with a fluid, dimensional script.
graphicDevices: Musical instrument silhouettes (harmonica, cigar box guitar)

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the western/Victorian spurred serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary elegance for the secondary flowing text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense, square-format illustration in the style of a 19th-century bank note or engraving. The left two-thirds should be filled with intricate golden filigree, floral scrolls, and musical icons (harmonica, guitar). The right third should feature a desaturated, sepia-toned man in rock star attire (sequined jacket, sunglasses) leaning against the graphic area. Leave specific paths clear for diagonal and horizontal text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom 3D beveled lettering in gold. The top text should be a large, spurred Victorian serif. The bottom text should be a flowing, dimensional script set on a diagonal upward arc. Add deep shadows to make the text appear as if it is physically mounted on the engraved background.

verificationChecks: Is the text beveled and metallic?
Does the subject appear desaturated compared to the gold background?
Is every gap in the graphic area filled with engraving-style detail?
Is the frame distressed and double-bordered?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold metallic sheen
Degree of sepia tint in the photograph
Angle of the diagonal text arcs
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Identifiable portrait features of a living celebrity

mustAchieve: Harmonious integration of photo and illustration

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold doesn't look like flat yellow.
Check that the subject's arm correctly overlaps the background elements.
Verify that the filigree doesn't obscure the legibility of the beveled text.
Confirm the outer border has a realistic paper-distress texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Victorian Engraving Style] + [3D Beveled Gold Typography] + [Desaturated Sepia Portrait] + [Horror Vacui Composition] to create a vintage rock-and-roll aesthetic.
